  • 构造器详细资料

    • JobPosting

      public JobPosting(String jobId, String moId, String subject, String workType, String description, String skillRequirement, String hoursPerWeek, String compensation, String status)
      Creates a job posting model. Null field values are normalised to empty strings.
      参数:
      jobId - unique job identifier
      moId - module organiser identifier
      subject - job subject or module name
      workType - type of work, such as Lab or Tutorial
      description - job description
      skillRequirement - comma-separated skill requirements
      hoursPerWeek - expected weekly working hours
      compensation - compensation description
      status - current job status
